text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text: Oooh, to think she could go this far...!

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
There's still some awkwardness.
However, compared to the first demonstration,
it is a remarkable improvement!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, it seems you've managed to
barely keep your balance now.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
After reconnecting all sorts of modules every which way, the posture control improved too.
I suppose it's at a passing grade for now.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer, and everyone else too.
This is all thanks to
the help every one of you gave me.
choice_data_list: No, no, this is just the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
No doubt about it.
I barely managed to keep up appearances, after all.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell I'm gonna get carried away by something like this.
Right now, this is still just club activity playtime."

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
From here, that's what I'll aim for.
A machine that moves freely, just as I envision.

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
Ah, then Trainer.
I will require a post-race tuning right away.
And then—

text_block_list.name: ST-2 (Satie)
text_block_list.text:
"Let us set the next Upgrade Exam
for June of next year."
choice_data_list: Six months from now, then. Got it!

text_block_list.text:
And so, the Upgrade Exam concluded.
Next, it was time to move on to "tuning."
